        public void deliver​(java.awt.Graphics2D gfx,
                    java.awt.geom.Rectangle2D viewport,
                    java.awt.Point offset,
                    ViewportPositionValidator viewportPositionValidator)
        Delivers the current supply of render packets to the graphics object
        Parameters:
        gfx - the specified graphics object to deliver render packets to
        viewport - the specified bounds of the window in to the game
        offset - the specified offset to apply to the position of sprites
        viewportPositionValidator - the specified viewport position validator used to validate the position of sprite images

        public void draw​(java.lang.String spritesheet,
                 double x,
                 double y,
                 int tile,
                 int mirror,
                 int scale,
                 int alpha)
        Draws a sprite which is an 8x8 pixel image
        Specified by:
        draw in interface DrawAPI
        Parameters:
        spritesheet - the specified spritesheet to get the image from
        x - the specified x position to render the image
        y - the specified y position to render the image
        tile - the specified tile image on the spritesheet to render
        mirror - the specified direction to mirror the image
        scale - the specified scale to resize the image to
        alpha - the specified alpha value to apply to the image
